_comment: USD per MILLION tokens. Short-context rates (< 200k prompt tokens) from https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing (checked 2026-08-16). Long-context (2x) is not modeled here. Grok has no 5m/1h cache-write tiers: cache creation is billed as regular input, so cache_write_* matches input. Re-check the pricing page if these look stale.

_rate_shape.cache_write_5m: unused on Grok; set equal to input so cache_creation tokens price as uncached input
_rate_shape.cache_write_1h: unused on Grok; set equal to input so cache_creation tokens price as uncached input
